_about: Official closures shown at the top of route pages, on cards and in the DOC directory. Each quote must appear word for word in data/evidence/<route>.json, or the build stops. Dates: annual = MM-DD each year; dated = YYYY-MM-DD. All judged on New Zealand date (Pacific/Auckland). An official closure overrides the DOC Tracks open-data status.

closures.quote: The track is closed for lambing from 1 October to 10 November each year. It reopens on 11 November.
Track annually closed for fawning between 20 November and 20 December.

section.zh: Whakapapa 村至 Mangatepopo 小屋段

closures.quote: This section of track is closed due to the 2025 Tongariro fire and will not be available for the 2026/27 Great Walk season.

dateNote.en: Dates are the 2026/27 Great Walks season on the same DOC page (23 October 2026 – 30 April 2027).
dateNote.zh: 日期取自同一 DOC 页面的 2026/27 大步道季（2026 年 10 月 23 日至 2027 年 4 月 30 日）。
